description: Manual visual audit of the MediaPipe landmark overlays (data/overlays/) against the original photos. For each image: did the detector capture the two GRIPPING hands (not just any hands), and are the landmarks plausible enough to recover the grip type? grip_capture: both_hands_good = both gripping hands detected with individually plausible skeletons; chimera = a single detected 'hand' whose skeleton actually spans both gripping hands (or each detection merges a joined pair); one_hand_only = exactly one gripping hand tracked, partner missed; wrong_hands = detections landed on free/background hands, grip missed; none = nothing detected. recoverable: could the grip type be classified from these landmarks alone (yes / partial / no).
